plan: [I will bid my value. This is because, in the ascending clock auction, I want to stay in as long as the price is below my value. By bidding my value, I ensure that I exit the auction exactly when the clock reaches my value. If I bid lower than my value, I might exit too early and miss out on a profitable opportunity. If I bid higher than my value, I risk winning at a price higher than my value, resulting in a loss. Therefore, bidding my true value is the optimal strategy.]

[My value is $7. I want to maximize my profit. If I bid too low, I might miss out on a profitable opportunity. If I bid too high, I risk winning but with a very small profit or even a loss. A good strategy is to bid slightly below my value to ensure a profit if I win, but also to avoid overpaying. I will bid $6, which is below my value, but high enough to potentially win if the other bidders have lower values. This strategy aims to balance the probability of winning with the profitability of winning.]
